verdict.rationale: Working Copy's automation surface (x-callback-url) has only a single app-generated secret key gating data-changing and content-reading commands. There is no evidence of issuing multiple credentials, scoping them to specific repositories or actions, or creating least-privilege tokens for an agent. The single secret is an adjacent access control, not scoped credential issuance.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
